methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The purpose of the analysis was to assess the effectiveness of its implementation, to identify the existence of gaps and to develop improvements capable of fulfilling the identified gaps

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper analyses the ISO 50001:2011 energy management systems standard, identifies gaps relative to sustainable development, and proposes six standard-requirement changes validated through an expert-opinion online survey (146 experts). It does not present, propose, evaluate, or critique any EnPI/EnB measurement model; energy performance, energy intensity and ROI are mentioned only incidentally as concepts, with no model variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach identifiable.

paper_type.evidence_quote: a quantitative and descriptive research method was used

stage1.notes: Standard gap-analysis plus expert-opinion survey (146 experts) validating proposed ISO 50001:2011 improvements; no EnPI/EnB measurement model presented or characterised (ineligible).
